verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs do have an API reference section, with page titles like 'Integration Monitoring' and 'Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs'. But no evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths all returned 404. A static API reference is adjacent to this story and does not deliver an interactive, runnable explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
